question.text: The Margin Period of Risk (MPOR) for commodity index futures must be at least:

explanation.text: The Logic: Per workbook p.41, initial margin must be based on 99% confidence VaR with an MPOR of at least 2 days, in line with CPMI-IOSCO principles. The Trap: 1 day is the MPOR for cash equity markets. 5 and 7 days are not specified minimums for commodity index derivatives. Note: Per workbook p.42, the MPOR can be increased during periods of market uncertainty above the 2-day minimum.
